name: 尼古拉斯·赫米克
name_full: 尼古拉斯·赫米克 Nicolas Hermick
introduction: Nicolas Hermick is an American actor and singer who graduated with a degree in Musical Theatre from Baldwin Wallace University. Demonstrating strong stage credentials, he notably portrayed Doody in Grease at The Argyle Theatre. In 2026, he transitioned into on-screen prominence, capturing international acclaim and a dedicated fanbase for his leading role as Kit in the hit vertical-screen drama series Next Door.Nicolas Hermick 是一位毕业于鲍德温华莱士大学音乐剧系的美国青年演员与歌手。他具备扎实的舞台功底，曾在阿盖尔剧院的音乐剧《油脂》中饰演 Doody。2026年，他因在热门短剧《Next Door》中领衔主演男主角 Kit 而在荧幕上崭露头角，凭借细腻的演技与极具感染力的化学反应赢得了大量海外剧迷的喜爱与广泛关注。
